comments.author: (Wen zhi)
comments.body: Well done. All pet quests are like that. You don't receive a ticket instantly. The pet goes to the trainer and you can leave it there for as long as you want, move it to your quarters or issue a deed to carry it with you. Note that the same pet quest is not repeatable while your pet is with the trainer (certain about this), at your quarters or in ticket form in your inventory (almost certain about these two). You can get the same quest for another peacock though if you sell / give your current one.
